profiles.label: Standard HTML projection
semantic_requirements: preserve public route identity and source route meaning
preserve source, evidence, status, rights, risk, limitation, and action-gate meaning
show candidate, absence, conflict, disabled-live, and no-download limitations where present
forbidden_omissions: rights, risk, no-download, no-install, no-execute, no-upload, and no-live-probe warnings
notes: Standard HTML is a projection of existing public-safe meaning, not separate truth.
Forms remain public/read-only selectors or disabled handoff UI unless later runtime tasks authorize behavior.

profiles.label: Lite HTML projection
semantic_requirements: preserve resolver source/evidence/status meaning with simpler markup
preserve rights, risk, limitations, absence, conflict, and disabled-action warnings
avoid JavaScript, CSS-dependent meaning, cookies, credentials, and private state
forbidden_omissions: warnings that are visible in standard HTML
source/evidence/status fields required to understand a result
notes: Lite HTML is a first-class projection for old and low-capability clients, not a disposable fallback.
It must not silently discard source/evidence/status meaning.

profiles.label: HTML 3.2-compatible projection
semantic_requirements: preserve public-safe source, evidence, status, rights, risk, and limitation text in old markup
avoid CSS-only or script-only meaning
retain no-auth, no-cookie, no-credential, no-write, no-download, and no-live-probe posture
notes: HTML 3.2 compatibility is a future contract profile and does not create a new renderer or route.
It is intended for old-client HTTP-compatible read-only hosts.

profiles.label: Plain text projection
semantic_requirements: preserve source, evidence, status, rights, risk, limitation, and action-gate meaning in plain text
make absence, conflict, candidate, unknown, and disabled-live states explicit
avoid relying on color, layout, images, JavaScript, cookies, or private state
forbidden_omissions: warnings because they are visually inconvenient
source/evidence references because output is text-only
route, status, risk, rights, and limitation labels
notes: Plain text is a first-class projection for text browsers, terminals, screen readers, and simple automation.
It is not a lossy emergency fallback.

profiles.label: File-tree projection
semantic_requirements: preserve public-safe manifest, checksum, source, evidence, status, and limitation meaning
distinguish manifests and checksums from executable downloads or mirrors
keep private paths, credentials, tokens, writes, uploads, and live probes absent
notes: File-tree is a first-class projection for static public data and future snapshots.
It does not enable mirrors, downloads, installers, execution, or writable file access.

profiles.label: API JSON projection
semantic_requirements: preserve schema_version, status, source, evidence, rights, risk, limitations, and action gates in machine-readable form
distinguish static data, local runtime outputs, and future hosted API outputs
avoid undocumented private fields, credentials, tokens, and live-source side effects
forbidden_omissions: risk, rights, limitation, and disabled-action fields
notes: API JSON is an output profile, not a hosted backend claim.
It must not imply that reserved API routes are live or production-stable.

profiles.label: Manifest JSON projection
semantic_requirements: preserve manifest scope, provenance, status, checksum, and limitation meaning
distinguish manifest/download metadata from executable payload availability
retain no-private-data, no-credentials, no-writes, and no-live-probe posture
forbidden_omissions: no executable download and no install warnings
notes: Manifest JSON supports public-safe summaries and future snapshots.
It is not a download grant or rights clearance claim.

profiles.label: Future snapshot projection
semantic_requirements: preserve snapshot manifest, checksums, source, evidence, status, rights, risk, and limitation meaning
distinguish seed examples from production signed releases
avoid executable payload, private data, real signing key, and public /snapshots/ route claims
forbidden_omissions: no executable download and no production signature warning
notes: Snapshot remains future/deferred and does not publish a public /snapshots/ route.
This profile prepares Track D without implementing snapshot runtime or production signing.

profiles.label: Future relay projection
semantic_requirements: preserve public-read-only source/evidence/status meaning across relay transports
distinguish relay projection from relay runtime, proxying, sockets, or protocol servers
keep private data, credentials, API tokens, writes, downloads, live probes, and unsafe actions disabled
forbidden_omissions: public-read-only limitations for insecure or old clients
no private data, no credentials, no writes, and no live-probe warnings
notes: Relay is future/deferred and no network listener or protocol server exists.
This profile is a contract for later Track D relay planning only.

profiles.label: Future terminal projection
semantic_requirements: preserve text profile semantics for terminal and CLI-oriented views
make source/evidence/status, risk, rights, limitations, and disabled actions visible without color
avoid private state, telemetry, downloads, execution, or live-source side effects
forbidden_omissions: risk, rights, limitations, and disabled-action warnings
candidate, absence, conflict, and unknown states
notes: Terminal projection is future/deferred and does not alter the existing CLI.
It prepares semantic parity with text output.

profiles.label: Future native card projection
semantic_requirements: preserve source/evidence/status meaning in compact native-client cards
preserve action safety, rights, risk, limitations, candidate, absence, and conflict states
avoid engine internals, private local paths, credentials, downloads, installers, execution, and telemetry
forbidden_omissions: rights, risk, limitation, and disabled-action warnings
notes: Native card is future/deferred and does not create native projects or clients.
Future native clients must consume governed contracts, not engine internals.

profiles.label: Print projection
semantic_requirements: preserve source/evidence/status, rights, risk, limitation, and action-gate meaning when printed
keep URLs, source labels, evidence summaries, and caveats visible without interactive controls
avoid hiding warnings because they are not visually compact
forbidden_omissions: rights, risk, limitations, and disabled-action warnings
candidate, conflict, absence, and unknown states
notes: Print is a future projection profile only.
It does not create print routes or generated artifacts.
Plain text, lite HTML, and file-tree profiles are first-class projections, not disposable fallbacks.
Every representation profile must preserve resolver identity, route meaning, source/evidence/status semantics, rights/risk limitations, and disabled-action posture.
This inventory does not change public routes, runtime behavior, hosted behavior, source connectors, live probes, native projects, downloads, uploads, accounts, or telemetry.
